answer: Require each identity to answer a gale of timed signal pings from unrelated verifiers, triangulating to one consistent latency profile. Each ping carries a yarrow token expiring in milliseconds, so forwarding it adds measurable delay. A controller answering for many clones from one machine shows identical timing, while scattered forwarding breaks the profile; each fake therefore needs its own always-on, independently placed responder, a per-identity cost no clone can share.
